source.sqlReaderQuery: USE [CMS]  /****** Pulls daily records related to Opioid from CMS database******/  SET ANSI_NULLS ON SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON SET NOCOUNT ON  DECLARE @TRRCreateDate AS DATETIME SET @TRRCreateDate = CONVERT(DATETIME, DATEDIFF(DAY, 0, ?)-1)   SELECT  TRR.ClaimNbr AS HICN,  		TRR.LastName,  		TRR.FirstName,  		TRR.MiddleName AS MiddleInitial,  		TRR.Gender,  		TRR.DOB,  		TRR.ContractNbr,  		TRR.StateCode,  		TRR.CountyCode,  		TRR.HospiceIndicator,  		TRR.NHCIndicator,  		TRR.ReplyCode,  		TRR.TransactionTypeCode,  		TRR.EffectiveTransactionDate,  		TRR.PBP,  		TRR.TransactionDate,  		CASE WHEN TRR.ReplyCode = '322' THEN TRR.ReplyCodeDependantValue ELSE TRR.SourceID END  AS SourceID,  ReplyCode 322 has SourceID in a different field. 		TRR.TRCShortName,  		TRR.SystemAssignedTrackingId,  		TRR.PlanAssignedTrackingId,  		CASE TRR.ReplyCode  			WHEN '014' THEN '01'     		WHEN '071' THEN '02' 			WHEN '321' THEN '03' 			WHEN '322' THEN '04' 			WHEN '090' THEN '05' 			WHEN '091' THEN '06' 			WHEN '072' THEN '07' 		END AS TRCProcessingCodeForHRS,   		'WLP' AS SubSponsor,  		'UNK' AS MembershipSystem,  		'UNK' AS HCID FROM CMS.dbo.TRR2K11D_2011TRDDailyRecords AS TRR WITH (NOLOCK) 	WHERE  TRR.ContractNbr <> 'S2893' AND 	( 	  (((TRR.ReplyCode IN ('071','072') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate))   Hospice On, Hospice Off 	OR ((TRR.ReplyCode = '014' AND TRR.TransactionTypeCode = '51') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate)  Disenroll new plan 	OR ((TRR.ReplyCode = '321' AND TRR.TransactionTypeCode = '90') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate)   TC90 Record Accepted by CMS 	OR  	((TRR.ReplyCode = '322' AND TRR.TransactionTypeCode = '61') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate)   Transferred with POS Restriction 	OR ((TRR.ReplyCode in ('090','091') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate)))  Deceased, Death Date Off 	)

USE [CMS]  /****** Pulls member span data related to daily records pulled earlier******/  SET ANSI_NULLS ON SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON SET NOCOUNT ON  DECLARE @TRRCreateDate AS DATETIME SET @TRRCreateDate = CONVERT(DATETIME, DATEDIFF(DAY, 0, ?)-1)   SELECT HCID,        ClaimNumber, 	   [System], 	   EnrollmentStartDate, 	   EnrollmentEndDate  FROM CMS.dbo.TRR2K11D_2011TRDDailyRecords AS TRR WITH (nolock) INNER JOIN [DB_Enrollment_MA_Enterprise].[dbo].[vw_MAMemberSpans] MBR 	 ON TRR.ClaimNbr = MBR.ClaimNumber WHERE  TRR.ContractNbr <> 'S2893' AND ( 	(((TRR.ReplyCode IN ('071','072') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate))   Hospice On, Hospice Off OR ((TRR.ReplyCode = '014' AND TRR.TransactionTypeCode = '51') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate)  Disenroll new plan OR ((TRR.ReplyCode = '321' AND TRR.TransactionTypeCode = '90') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate)   TC90 Record Accepted by CMS OR  ((TRR.ReplyCode = '322' AND TRR.TransactionTypeCode = '61') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate)   Transferred with POS Restriction OR ((TRR.ReplyCode in ('090','091') AND TRR.CreateDate > @TRRCreateDate)))  Deceased, Death Date Off )
